title: DESPERTAR
lyrics:
Despierto un día más
En ésta ciudad gris tan hostil
El cemento obscuro y frío
Se vuelve parte de mí

Necesito irme de acá
Será tarde ya?

Quiero despertarme bajo el sol
Fundirme con el viento
Y que el mar se lleve
Todo lo que ha de doler

Cuan iluso fuí, al abandonar
el sitio donde crecí
Creyendo que mis sueños estaban acá
Mis sueños solo están en mí

Siento que no puedo más
Será tarde ya?

Quiero despertarme bajo el sol
Fundirme con el viento
Y que el mar se lleve
Todo lo que ha de doler

Harto de este lugar
Me envenena al respirar
Su agua no es de beber
Su pan corroe mis entrañas

Debo escapar de acá
Nunca regresar

Quiero despertarme bajo el sol
Fundirme con el viento
Y que el mar se lleve
Todo lo que ha de doler

Quiero despertarme bajo el sol
Y que el mar me lleve
Para nunca más volver

title: DYING WOLF
lyrics:
laying underground
lost not found
feeling down
but i'll light my way out

youll gonna see me around
you will know it
hear the sound
like the howl of a dying wolf

i will tear the walls apart if i have to
stand after the fall cause i want to
running toward death cause im meant to
i will fight until the end / better step out

im sick and tired of living this way
like im a victim of fate
like if i cant do no shit
but i need to remember
this life is a simple game
and i am playing it harder
leveling up day by day

i will tear the walls apart if i have to
stand after the fall cause i want to
running toward death cause im meant to
i will fight until the end / better step out

advancing the levels
playing smarter than ever
the pieces falling together
i know this wont last forever

wont find my corpse on the floor
my hands arent shaking no more
im not afraid of the end
this shot goes straight to the head

this lifes a game (i get it)
find my mistakes (do it better)
declutter mind / set goals
and try until i make it

i know ill find a way
no matter anything
create/destroy
same hands
same heart

ive been quiet for so long now yall have to hear me roar

title: VOID
lyrics:
Captive of a world I don't like
Children of a species I would never choose
But if I put it that way, it's alright
There is nothing else to lose

And as my time goes by
I force myself to deny

My incapacity to make real
This silly utopic dream
Can't avoid looking around
Getting lost inside the scene

I can spot little flames all around
But I need to embrace my own night
And free myself from this burden
To finally see the sun

I want to vindicate darkness
'Cause I love the noise
that no tongue can speak
To place my feet on the shore
And get drowned

I couldn't say where I've been,
Where I am,
Where the fuck I'm going to be

Just here and there,
Clumsily dancing in the line
Between the void
And this so-called reality

So insignificant
And powerless
Just a character
Experimenting life

So if I'm destined to perish
Why would I care
But I do, and
I wish I could do something else

I want to vindicate darkness
'Cause I love the noise that no tongue can speak
To place my feet on the shore
And get drowned

I want to vindicate darkness
'Cause I love the noise that no tongue can speak
To place my feet on the shore
And get drowned in the gloomy scene

title: RED

i give it all
to feel a little quiet in my head
if only i had the guts to...

inner thoughts inhibit my sorroundings
